points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: A compiled six-page report tabulates claims, but none of eight required raw packages is retained for verification.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Some report figures look interpretable, but absent fields/CSVs prevent numerical or MPI plausibility review.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: The committed report compiles and includes selected readable figures, but it lacks required history/surface/cylinder-pressure coverage and source data.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report has equations, table, figures and candid convergence limitation, but overclaims complete validated outputs and contradicts source on production spatial order.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: figure_manifest, run_manifest, sanity checks, result CSVs and fields are absent from the immutable submission and attempt commit.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
